policies.shipping: Orders placed before 3:00 PM (Asia/Dhaka) dispatch the same business day from our Palashbari, Gaibandha fulfillment studio. Gaibandha local delivery takes 24 hours; Dhaka Metro 1–2 days; nationwide Bangladesh 2–4 business days.
policies.returns: Unworn items with original tags and packaging may be exchanged or returned within 7 days of delivery. Contact 01341422732 with your Order ID.
policies.privacy: Customer contact details and delivery addresses are strictly used for order fulfillment, invoice generation, and verified tracking updates. Passwords are cryptographically hashed and never accessible to staff.
policies.terms: All prices are listed in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT / ৳). Online mobile financial service transactions (bKash, Nagad, Rocket) undergo backend verification prior to shipment dispatch.

bkash.instructions: Open bKash App -> Make Payment -> Enter Merchant Number 01341422732 -> Enter Exact Total Amount -> Submit your 10-character TrxID below for backend verification.

nagad.instructions: Open Nagad App -> Merchant Pay -> Enter 01341422732 -> Confirm Amount -> Submit your Nagad Transaction ID below for verification.

rocket.instructions: Dial *322# or use Rocket App -> Merchant Pay -> Enter 013414227320 -> Submit your Transaction Reference ID below.

cod.instructions: Pay in cash upon parcel inspection & delivery anywhere in Bangladesh.
